name: Lessons Anew
summary: Mathrengyl Bearwalker sends Alliance druids from Darnassus to Moonglade for training. There, Dendrite Starblaze begins their instruction in cleansing venom and toxins.

sections.title: A Gift from Cenarius
sections.body: Druids learn from Cenarius, the demigod whose teachings and blessings bind them to the living world. His gifts include the power to cleanse venom with a simple incantation. Such power is not given lightly. Before young druids can wield it, they must learn the hard, ordinary work of fighting toxins without nature's magic.

sections.title: Summons to Nighthaven
sections.body: Mathrengyl Bearwalker trains druids in Darnassus's Cenarion Enclave. He sends his student past local practice and on to Moonglade. In Nighthaven, Dendrite Starblaze coordinates the Cenarion Circle's wider efforts and has practical work for the novice.

sections.title: A Real-World Crisis
sections.body: In Nighthaven, initiates face a real crisis rather than a staged trial or ritual. Auberdine, on the Darkshore coast, suffers a wave of animal poisonings that its people cannot stop. Dendrite Starblaze sends the novice to investigate and aid Darkshore, where lives are at stake.

faq.q: Who offers the quest Lessons Anew?
faq.answer: Mathrengyl Bearwalker, the night elf druid trainer in Darnassus's Cenarion Enclave, offers it.

faq.q: Where do I need to go to complete this quest?
faq.answer: Travel to Moonglade and report to Dendrite Starblaze in Nighthaven.

faq.q: Why must druids learn to cure poisons like a layman first?
faq.answer: Druid mentors believe that Cenarius's gift of curing venom with an incantation can breed complacency. Studying ordinary ways to confront venom first teaches initiates to respect the burden and suffering poison causes.

faq.q: What problem is taking place in Auberdine?
faq.answer: Auberdine suffers severe animal poisonings along the Darkshore coast. The local night elves cannot cure them and have asked the Cenarion Circle in Moonglade for help.

faq.q: What ability does this quest chain eventually grant?
faq.answer: It begins the Power over Poison chain, which teaches druids Cure Poison, a spell that magically cleanses toxins from allies.

faq.q: Is this quest available to Horde druids?
faq.answer: No. Lessons Anew begins in Darnassus for Alliance druids. Tauren druids receive a parallel beginning in Thunder Bluff, which also sends them to Moonglade to learn to cure poison.

angles.text: As a druid, you move beyond basic shapeshifting and survival toward caring for the wilds, learning to lift lethal blights and venoms from nature.
From Darnassus's Cenarion Enclave, you are sent toward the deeper ancestral responsibilities tied to Moonglade and Darkshore.
As an Alliance member, you see how vital druidic aid is to the fragile northern settlements in Darkshore, including Auberdine.
